_comment: Write classes a role card may list in `owns`. Each class is a logical bucket of mxcli WRITE operations. The adapter uses these to generate policy/ownership.json entries that key the guard's rule R5. Phase 1 does not ship a 1:1 mapping from class → mxcli subcommands; that mapping arrives in phase 3 when the writer role is introduced.

model.domain.description: Changes to the project's domain model: entities, attributes, associations, enumerations, indexes.
